title: A docs sign-off still counts after main moves and the merged head is resubmitted
description: A fixture control plane: the master attests a manual:docs-updated/ proof, main moves with an unrelated change, the worker merges main and resubmits, and the acceptance gate passes on the merged head without a second attestation, because the documentation files it judged are unchanged (GY-3716).

steps.name: the merged head passes acceptance on the standing docs sign-off
